text:
Predicates:
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
Named(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
LoanedOutTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
FootballClub(x) ::: x is a football club.
SameClub(x, y) ::: x is a football club along with y.
Premises:
Named(ailtonSilva, ailton) ∧ FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ LoanedOutTo(ailtonSilva, braga) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton and was loaned out to Braga.
PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ∧ FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ FootballClub(nautico) ∧ FootballClub(braga) ∧ SameClub(nautico, braga) ::: Ailton is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Nautico, and Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
FootballClub(fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
¬PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, footballClub) ::: Ailton Silva does not play for a football club.
